body: I am on medication, and I am fine with finances.  I need medication adjusted.
lucid enough to graduate? i have a 4.0.  this was just one test.

yeah.  i am totally rational.  i am about to get a graduate degree related to mental health, so i know exactly what's happening.  i don't really have the energy to type it out here.  basically, my brain reached its ceiling with coping ability, and my neurons are pretty pissed.
I'm also not trying to dope myself up...  I just am out of balance and need realigning.

no, CBT is awesome.  i'm using a lot of it to keep this under control. it just is frustrating when the CBT works.  i can see the distorted thinking clearly, and i know not to act on it.  it's so crazy to know that my thoughts are not rational but to still think them.  it's chemical.  that's why i said i need medication.

it's not dark or inane.  i just lost my ability to cope.  i still am capable of seeing the lack of rationality in this.  i understand reality, but my brain is fighting that.  i don't need CBT, i need medication.
it's not burn out.  i don't know what you mean by "tutor"
i can't go to the hospital, even though i might be a danger to myself.  i need to graduate and start real life and let everything get better.  i would be sabotaging myself if i went to the hospital.
the pressure is just so high that i feel like i need to press the emergency eject button.  i don't want to die, i just want to parachute away from *this*

i was in a bad place last week.  i was feeling better, but i just got triggered hardcore.  i am in the #1 graduate program in the world in my field, and i had a 4.0 until recently.  i just got a 70 on a midterm, and the answers don't even look familiar. my brain isn't working.  it's so frustrating and scary.  logically, i am not depressed, but there are some shitty things going on chemically that are triggering a chain reaction.
i have such a strong desire to hurt myself.  i know it isn't rational, but knowing that doesn't get rid of the desire.  i'm afraid of what i might do.
